attributes.action: Bring back UK pet passport urgently before 2027.
attributes.additional_details: Recent changes prevent UK residents from using EU pet passports, forcing them to obtain costly Animal Health Certificates for each trip. This incurs costs for every journey and creates unnecessary stress and complexity.  Frequent travellers are disproportionately affected. A year ago, the Government explored reintroducing a pet passport scheme but has not confirmed a date. We ask for the Pet passport to be reintroduced within the next 9 months with no further delays or excuses.
attributes.background: Reintroduce the UK pet passport urgently.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: Seek agreement with the EU to accept pet passports for UK-EU travel https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/767906
